verdict.rationale: Every skill's SKILL.md must include a `name` and `description` [docs-13]. The agent decides when to activate a skill from that name and description before loading the full instructions [docs-49], so the description serves as both what the skill does and its trigger. The skill creator explicitly asks what the skill does and when it should trigger [docs-7], skills can be inspected via `/skills` or the desktop Skills sidebar [docs-20, docs-29], and a hands-on install confirmed valid frontmatter [probe-rt-2]. Missing for 10: a separate, enforced field for activation conditions beyond the free-text description, deterministic or previewable activation behavior (it is model-decided), and independent corroboration that third-party or curated skills consistently document their triggers.
